title: Harbison Protection Contracts Terms: Start of the Unused Period on a Labor-Only Cancellation
content:
**Condition.** On the cancellation of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the unused period starts on the refund start date:

(a) where a Harbison installation contract in scheduled status replaces the covered unit, the refund start date is that installation's scheduled date — read from the installation contract under Replacement System Installations that names the covered unit as the unit being replaced;

(b) where no such installation is scheduled and the holder's pending written cancellation request was received before the date of confirmation, it is the date that request was received;

(c) otherwise it is the date the cancellation takes effect, which is the date of confirmation.

**Order of the branches.** Branch (a) governs whenever a scheduled replacement exists, whatever the request's date; branch (b) is reached only where no replacement is scheduled.

| Scheduled Harbison replacement of the covered unit | Pending written request received before the date of confirmation | Refund start date |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | the installation's scheduled date |
| no | yes | the date the request was received |
| no | no (request received on the date of confirmation) | the date of confirmation |

**Illustrations (hypothetical dates).**

- A replacement installation for the covered furnace is scheduled for 4 May 2026; the written request was received 2 April 2026; the holder confirms on 10 April 2026. Refund start date: 4 May 2026.
- No replacement scheduled; written request received 2 April 2026; confirmation 10 April 2026. Refund start date: 2 April 2026.
- No replacement scheduled; the request is received and confirmed on 10 April 2026. Refund start date: 10 April 2026.
- An installation for the unit that is already completed, not in scheduled status, does not set the refund start date.
